# Global Horizon STEM Excellence Scholarship (Official Portal)
**Annual Undergraduate & Graduate Awards Program**

### Program Overview
The Global Horizon STEM Excellence Scholarship supports outstanding full-time students enrolled in accredited science, technology, engineering, or mathematics programs. The program awards a merit stipend of $12,500 per academic year.

### Eligibility Criteria
- Applicants must be currently enrolled full-time in an accredited undergraduate STEM program (junior or senior standing) or first-year graduate program.
- Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.65 on a 4.0 scale.
- Demonstrated financial need or citizenship status is not restricted; international students are welcome to apply.

### Application Deadline
The final application deadline for the 2026-2027 academic session is strictly November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Standard Time. Incomplete or late submissions will not be reviewed under any circumstances.

### Required Application Documents
All applicants must submit the following items through our official applicant portal:
1. Official university academic transcript showing coursework through Spring 2026.
2. Two letters of academic recommendation from departmental professors.
3. A 750-word personal statement detailing your STEM research background and career objectives.
4. Proof of household income via the previous tax year's Official W-2 Form or equivalent national tax return.

### Application Process
Create an account on portal.globalhorizonstem.org, complete the personal profile section, upload all PDF documents, and submit before the deadline. There are no application fees.

### Contact Information
For admissions inquiries, contact the Scholarship Review Board at awards@globalhorizonstem.org or call +1 (800) 555-0199.

sources.rawText:
# STEM Grant Watch & Student Financial Tips
**Published on: October 15, 2026 | By Sarah Jenkins, Senior Academic Advisor**

### How to Land the Global Horizon STEM Scholarship this Fall
The Global Horizon STEM Excellence Award continues to be one of the highest-value awards open to tech students this season, offering up to $12,500. Having coached several applicants through the submission system, here are the critical guidelines to watch out for.

### Eligibility and Selection
The foundation looks closely at research aptitude and GPA. While they officially state a 3.65 minimum GPA, competitive candidates usually possess 3.8+ along with independent lab experience.

### Crucial Note on Required Documents (Conflict Alert)
Pay special attention to the financial verification requirements:
While older materials asked for W-2 forms, the updated compliance guidelines require submission of an Signed IRS Form 1040 (pages 1 and 2), and specifically state that standalone W-2 slips are NOT accepted as proof of income. If you upload only a W-2, your application may be disqualified during initial document screening.

Furthermore, applicants must provide three letters of recommendation rather than two, with at least one letter written by an industry supervisor or internship mentor.

### Deadline Warning
The deadline on the applicant dashboard is set for November 30, 2026. However, recommendation letters must be uploaded by professors 48 hours prior to the final cutoff.

### Questions?
Feel free to drop a comment below or email our advisory team at help@stemgrantwatch.org.

# Global Horizon Foundation Archives & Previous Grant Guidelines
**Archived Announcement — 2023-2024 Award Cycle**

### Global Horizon STEM Excellence Scholarship Notice
This archived page summarizes the terms for recipients of the 2023-2024 academic cycle.

### Key Deadlines & Cycle Notes
- Application Submission Deadline: December 15, 2023. Late submissions were archived without evaluation.
- Award Notification Date: February 28, 2024.

### Previous Criteria & Awards
- Scholarship amount was $10,000 per academic year distributed across two semesters.
- Minimum cumulative GPA required was 3.50.
- Renewal terms for the 2023 cohort required maintaining a minimum 3.4 GPA and 15 hours of community STEM outreach each semester.

### Important Notice
Please note that these rules and dates pertain exclusively to the closed 2023-2024 cycle. Current students should navigate to the updated portal for active deadlines and criteria.
